rules_applied: compact: preserved insertion order and removed whitespace
jcs: sorted keys by UTF-16 code units, not locale: C(0x43) < a(0x61) < b(0x62)
recursed into nested objects including objects inside arrays
sorted inner object keys a<z
sorted array-element object keys x<y
kept array order unchanged
n1=1e21 is on the >=1e21 boundary so ECMAScript/JCS emits 1e+21
n2=1e-7 is below 1e-6 so emits exponential 1e-7
n3=0.000001 equals 1e-6 so decimal notation 0.000001
n4=100000000000000000000 is 1e20, below 1e21, so plain integer digits
n5=-0 serializes as 0 because negative zero is normalized
n6 uses shortest ECMAScript double representation 333333333.3333333
compared UTF-16 code units lexicographically
first code units: $(0x24) < a(0x61) < ü(0x00FC) < €(0x20AC)
therefore key order is $, aa, ü, €
s1 newline uses \n
s2 tab uses \t
s3 quote uses \"
s4 é is non-ASCII and is emitted raw as UTF-8, not \u00E9
s5 spaces are not control characters and remain literal
